And despite a relatively porous defense, the Parisians won 5-3, led by a brilliant performance from Vitinha. arts.ttl: PSG come from behind twice in eight-goal thriller against Tottenham
arts.sum: PSG score five, including a Vitinha hat-trick, as they defeat Tottenham Hotspur 5-3 in a thriller at Parc des Princes.

arts.ttl: Vitinha hat-trick inspires PSG to comeback victory over improved Spurs
arts.sum: An improved Tottenham were unable to hold on as they surrendered two leads against European champions PSG and fell to a 5-3 defeat in the Champions League.

arts.ttl: Vitinha’s PSG hat-trick blows Spurs away as Frank changes fail to solve riddle
arts.athr: David Hytner at Parc des Princes
arts.sum: There was no shame in this defeat for Tottenham, which represented progress after the north London derby disaster at Arsenal on Sunday. There were measures of encouragement ahead of the crucial Premier League home game against Fulham on Saturday, most notably in the shape of Randal Kolo Muani, the striker who is on loan from Paris Saint-Germain. Kolo Muani set up Richarlison for 1-0 and scored for 2-1 himself with a stinging volley. There would be another one for him before this wild tie was over. They were his first in Spurs’ colours.
